label: Whole-series first-optimum selected exercise
definition: The SAME original ReasonGuidedWholeExercise, including actual necessarily existing bearer, obtaining carried content, full fact valuation and contingent exercise, additionally executes a supplied ordered agenda: choose its first feasible optimum, with every preceding candidate failing optimality. This is a stronger analyst adequacy policy, not a historical attribution or established premise.
note: Weak policy accepts optimal choice with ties; strong policy additionally demands this positive procedural selector. The agenda is an independently supplied ordered list, never constructed by observing the chosen option. Uniform comparisons keep it fixed and quantify over all worlds, bearers, reason contents and recorded choices; they do not assume any choice occurs. Decision of eligibility is explicit only for the existence theorem. The agenda contains an eligible option iff the scanner selects one. Completeness of agenda coverage over real alternatives, its authority as a reason for the particular choice, content relevance, direction and independent calibration remain OPEN. Concrete mathematical example: a fixed two-option agenda with equal quality selects its first option; reversing it fails to explain the same recorded choice. This does not establish metaphysical possibility, productive power, source correspondence or root closure. A freely invented outcome-coded order would not discharge these obligations. A tied free-volition account is the rival weak framework, not refuted by this stronger policy.
